prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beDelivery feature poster with a real photo of smart lockers as the background. Use a solid red header carrying the white beDelivery wordmark and large white text 'Chủ động nhận hàng'. Add a yellow rounded panel with blue text 'Theo ý bạn'. On the locker wall, include the text 'ĐIỂM GIAO NHẬN HÀNG SMART BOX 24/7' and the 'viettel post' logo. In the foreground on the right, overlay illustrated courier hands presenting a cardboard parcel with a blue be logo toward the viewer. At the bottom left, add layered yellow and blue blocks reading 'HÌNH THỨC GIAO HÀNG MỚI'. Technical style: hybrid logistics infographic poster with real locker photo and vector courier overlay, bright utilitarian indoor lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
